messages:
Priya (CSM): Quick weekly health check for Nimbus Health — caching + batching snapshot.
Priya (CSM): Key numbers: hit rate 38% (-4pp w/w), avg batch size 2.6 (+0.1), cost per 1k tokens $6.20 (+12%), p95 gen latency 320ms, error rate 0.7% (client errors spike Wed).
Jordan (Account Lead): Thx. Any correlation with model rollout or traffic shape? @Maria?
Maria (Solutions): We rolled model v2.1 on Tue (canary -> 100%). v2.1 increases avg tokens/response (~+15%) which explains spend up. Also noticing cache key churn from session ids and varying prompt prefixes.
Sam (Infra): Quick infra read: batching window currently 10ms for Nimbus. Under their traffic pattern that yields small batches during troughs. Suggest testing 30ms batch window + enable KV prefetch for top 200 prefixes; should increase batch size and hit rate.
Priya (CSM): Concern: will 30ms bump p95 past SLA? Nimbus cares about sub-400ms p95.
Sam (Infra): Projection: p95 + ~20ms (so ~340ms) but cost/1k could drop to ~ $4.80 if hit rate improves to ~55%. I'll run simulations and AB test.
Maria (Solutions): Also recommending client-side key normalization to reduce churn (strip session tokens, normalize whitespace). Expected hit-rate lift ~12-18pp. I'll prepare an SDK patch.
Maria (Solutions): Example normalization snippet for SDK: 
```js
// drop session ids, collapse whitespace, lowercase
function normalizeKey(prompt){
  return prompt.replace(/\bsession_id:\S+/i, '').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().toLowerCase();
}
```
Jordan (Account Lead): Good plan. Suggest small AB in staging, then 10% canary in prod. Keep Nimbus PM in the loop — they want cost/latency tradeoffs.
Priya (CSM): Action items: 
- @Sam: run 30ms batch-window AB in staging by Thu (monitor p95 + batch distribution)
- @Maria: SDK normalization PR by Fri (include unit tests)
- @Priya: schedule Monday ROI review with Nimbus PM and attach cost projections + AB dashboard
Sam (Infra): I'll tag metrics tenant:nimbus for batch_size, hit_rate, cost_per_1k and push dashboard tiles. Also will simulate 30ms in staging to validate CPU/GPU scheduling impact.
ops-bot: Alert: 1809990123 - serve-err spike auto-fallback triggered, transient GPU OOM, mitigated by fallback to smaller model.
Jordan (Account Lead): Renewal risk: LOW right now, but call Monday to show scenarios (status quo vs batching+normalization). If we hit projected cost savings, that'll reduce churn risk.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update Nimbus with proposed timeline after we see staging AB results.
